cohorts.label: 100h+
cohorts.summary: Long-term users report earning passive items through typing, smooth background performance, resolved initial bugs, and very demanding achievement requirements.

claims.claim: Reviewers note that achievements are challenging to unlock, with some requirements scaled to high numbers like 25 million clicks.

citations.review_text:
I installed this game/desktop companion to check why it is so popular. The game was free, and all achievements were easy to get. After 30 minutes, two chests appear near your cat; the first adds a skin or hat to your inventory, and the second gives you an emoji. Each chest "costs" 1000 clicks. The items can have different rarities: epic, legendary, common, etc., and corresponding drop chances. You can exchange 10 items of a given rarity for items of a higher rarity. You can sell the items on the Steam market, and I think that is one of the main attractions for this game. 

While the companion is still free, the achievement has been changed; the hardest one was 1 million clicks, now it is 25 million, which is very difficult to get without cheating. The art is cute, though.

This little side game is amazing. You can invite friends or join others and see their little cat emojis dance around and change appearance as time goes on. Neat little game if you like to achievement hunt, the ones on here are pretty hard to get so it's a nice flex to your friends and public users viewing your profile, You can play this in the background while you play your other favorite games and it'll track everything, pretty neat huh!! Overall great free game to have on your profile, lots of customization options.
 10/10 Recommend! 
Still trying to unlock certain achievements myself, GO Bongo CAT!!
